title: Richie Rich Yen for a Yeti #4 of 4 Kizoic Ape Entertainment 2011 Jason Burns
condition_description: Light edge wear and a few small creases; light surface wear and a small spot on the back cover. See photos.
description:
Richie Rich in Yen for a Yeti! #4 of 4 (2011), Kizoic / Ape Entertainment - young reader. Richie and the gang rescue a captured yeti in the Himalayas and face poachers and a mystic order of ninja monks. Written by Jason M. Burns, cover by Rob Duenas. Squarebound, $3.95 cover price.

Condition: light edge wear and a few small creases; light surface wear and a small spot on the back cover (see photos).

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
